youtube.title: How Cats Always Land On Their Feet 🐈 #Shorts
youtube.description:
In 1894, a French scientist dropped a cat in front of a camera.

He wanted to know how cats always land on their feet. Its inner ear tells it which way is up in a split second. It twists its front half first, then its back half, like a spring. It has a super-flexible spine, and its collarbone isn't locked to its shoulders. Kittens learn it at just a few weeks old. But it isn't magic. They can still get hurt.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
